text:
olivia: Heads up — telemetry header rename landed in API canary: X-Route-Attr -> X-Rd-RouteMeta. Observability team says console mapping broke for ~10% of routes. Anyone on SDKs aware?

jon: We started seeing missing route counts and a few client errors in Go/TS SDKs. TS wrapper threw on header validation for exact key names.

anya: Py SDK is fine because we normalize headers, but Node and Go tests caught it. Repro with curl: `curl -H 'X-Rd-RouteMeta: foo' https://api.redwood.ai/generate` — client shim didn't emit legacy header so downstream console lost the key.

mara: Are servers rejecting requests without the legacy header or is the console ingestion pipeline assuming the old key?

jon: Server accepts both new and old headers. The problem is console/ingestion mapping still keys telemetry by the old header name, so dashboards show a drop.

sam: Opex suggested shipping a gateway shim to backfill the legacy header for historical backfill. For SDKs, I propose adding a compatibility layer that maps X-Rd-RouteMeta -> X-Route-Attr on send. Nonbreaking.

olivia: Sounds good. Can we do a minor patch release across SDKs that preserves behavior? Add an env opt-out so customers can disable the shim if they want to be strict.

anya: I'll prepare PRs for Python and TS. For Go we need to watch net/http header canonicalization. Quick Go example: ```go
// in request middleware
h := req.Header
if v := h.Get("X-Rd-RouteMeta"); v != "" {
    h.Set("X-Route-Attr", v)
}
```
This should be safe cross-platform.

jon: TS patch will map headers in the fetch wrapper and add unit tests. I'll open a PR and link. How long should we support the shim? 30 days? 90?

mara: Recommend 60 days. Console team will run per-route audits and report missing metrics. If backfill succeeds we flip deprecation and post a final removal date.

ci-bot: CI triggered: devex/sdks/telemetry-shim (#842) — integration tests failed on header-casing on Windows runners.

sam: I'll triage CI failures and add explicit tests for header casing across platforms.

olivia: Also we need clear release notes + migration guide. @mara can you add a console dashboard note and an example query for routes missing counts?

mara: On it. I'll add a dashboard tile, a saved query for routes with >10% drop, and instructions for backfill verification.

anya: :thumbsup: Aiming to get PRs out today and publish patch releases (<1.0) to avoid semantic-major churn.

jon: Ping me once PRs are green; I'll coordinate TS and Go releases and the SDK release calendar.

olivia: Thanks. Also let's expose an env flag RD_SDK_ROUTE_SHIM=enabled (default true) and log a debug line when we polyfill the legacy header so customers can opt-out if they see unexpected behavior.

sam: Noted — I'll update changelog, add the env var, and draft a short outbound note for Dedicated/Private customers.

olivia: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Keep the thread updated with PR links and release notes.
